prompt: What does the final command return?
explanation: post:1 holds redis and db; post:2 holds redis and cache. SINTER returns only the members present in every input set, which is exactly redis. SUNION would have returned all three distinct tags.
code:
SADD tags:post:1 redis db
SADD tags:post:2 redis cache
SINTER tags:post:1 tags:post:2
